sentence: This project designs ways to move quantum states and to search networks using continuous-time quantum walks.
This project studies how plants shape the microbes in desert soils by measuring airborne chemicals that the microbes eat and give off.
This project builds a dual-arm robot that pushes foliage aside and uses camera images to speed up picking during harvesting.
This project studies the environments and diets of hominin species to learn how they lived in the same places.
This project tries to find out which genes and molecular networks control how the silk of maize grows.
This project builds an array of telescopes that uses the quantum nature of light to image bright stars at extremely high resolution.
This project studies how soil nitrogen and phosphorus change plant genomes, plant traits and the communities that plants live in.
This project builds course modules and an experimental platform to teach cybersecurity for mobile health.
This project tries to build language tools for languages with little data by adding what experts know about how languages work.
This project acquires a mass spectrometer to study large molecules such as polymers, peptides, proteins and carbohydrates.
This project builds a computer model that follows people in 3D over time from video, along with the objects and surroundings around them.
This project sets up a center that uses artificial intelligence to improve safety, efficiency and cybersecurity in manufacturing.
This project studies how telomere proteins protect the ends of chromosomes and how abnormal repair and transcription are controlled in a fungus.
This project helps tiny aerial robots find their way through smoke, dust and darkness by using sound waves instead of light.
This project studies how to keep crowd work accurate and workers safe when people use artificial intelligence tools for it.
This project studies how groups of artificial intelligence agents can share tasks and work together without a central controller.
This project sets up a high-performance computing cluster that lets researchers simulate data and train artificial intelligence models.
